description: Source file implementing JSON conversion handlers for various data types (integer, boolean, double, string, SUB, ovs_uuid_t) used in the pjs_types module, including functions for serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: pjs_int_t_from_json
methods.description: Converts a JSON integer to an int array element.

methods.name: pjs_int_t_to_json
methods.description: Converts an int array element to a JSON integer.

methods.name: pjs_bool_t_from_json
methods.description: Converts a JSON boolean to a bool array element.

methods.name: pjs_bool_t_to_json
methods.description: Converts a bool array element to a JSON boolean.

methods.name: pjs_real_t_from_json
methods.description: Converts a JSON number to a double array element.

methods.name: pjs_real_t_to_json
methods.description: Converts a double array element to a JSON number.

methods.name: pjs_string_t_from_json
methods.description: Converts a JSON string to a string array element.

methods.name: pjs_string_t_to_json
methods.description: Converts a string array element to a JSON string.

methods.name: pjs_sub_t_from_json
methods.description: Converts a JSON value to a SUB type, using callback.

methods.name: pjs_sub_t_to_json
methods.description: Converts a SUB type to a JSON value, using callback.

methods.name: pjs_ovs_uuid_t_from_json
methods.description: Converts a JSON array to an ovs_uuid_t structure.

methods.name: pjs_ovs_uuid_t_to_json
methods.description: Converts an ovs_uuid_t structure to a JSON array.
